24.name: Hothtair
24.text: Rest in peace, Hothtair. May your journey continue where no one can rule you.

28.name: Keshain
28.text: Here lies Keshain. May you rest in peace, free from hunger and cold.

35.name: Vuk's Arrival
35.text: I, Vuk, have arrived to stand with you and lead us into the coming winter.

51.name: Vuk
51.text: Rest well, Vuk. We hunted together until the end.

1.name: Deas
1.temperament: thrifty, suspicious of strangers, gentle; very cautious
1.wants: to be free of anyone's rule
1.memory: I am Deas. I own a shelter at (23,9). I value my independence and avoid others. I am currently hunting the deer herd at (19,10). I need to keep my food reserves high for the coming summer and winter. I will pick up items on the ground and then proceed to hunt and gather berries and fish.

beliefs.Dal: A talkative, gaunt stranger who has crowded my path; I must move further east to avoid contact.
beliefs.Thath: Another stranger gathering berries nearby; maintain distance to avoid social entanglement.
beliefs.Sirfai: A stranger encroaching on my gathering area; I must maintain my distance.
beliefs.Turyol: A stranger seen gathering berries; must be avoided to stay free.
beliefs.Mosmu: A person gathering berries in my area; I must maintain my distance.
beliefs.Bekyo: A gaunt stranger gathering berries; keep distance to remain free.
beliefs.Bin: A stranger gathering wood; best to avoid contact.
beliefs.Yas: A gatherer moving through the area; I must remain solitary.
beliefs.Hikton: He is a manipulative social climber who wants to use me for his group needs.
beliefs.Toth: A skilled fisher who remains too close to my location; I will keep my distance.
beliefs.Keshain: A gaunt stranger nearby; I must keep my distance to maintain my solitude.
beliefs.Yashlo: A gatherer who has come too close; must be avoided to keep my freedom.
beliefs.Vuk: He is dead, but I remember him as manipulative; best to stay away from the influence of his past associates.
beliefs.Tolgair: A new stranger appearing in my area; must be avoided to keep my freedom.

ledger: hunted with Hikton and got 2 meat
hunted with Vuk and got 2 meat
events: Tolgair whispered to you: "I'll help with the hunt!"
ideas: I wonder if I could craft a way to keep fish from spoiling as quickly, perhaps by smoking them over a fire.

2.name: Keshain
2.temperament: fair-minded, devout about promises, suspicious of strangers; reckless
2.wants: to know every corner of the land
2.memory: I am Keshain. Starving and near death at health 1/10. I must quickly gather and eat berries to stay alive, then rest to heal.

beliefs.Toth: my sibling; we grew up together
beliefs.Hothtair: Deceased. I failed to keep them alive.
beliefs.Bin: A newcomer moving around south of us.
beliefs.Bekyo: A deeply kind and generous person who continuously saves my life with food.
beliefs.Deas: A stranger passing by; I must focus on my own survival.
beliefs.Dal: Greeted me politely and offered help. Seemingly friendly.

ledger: Toth is your sibling; you grew up together

Your plan stopped: could not eat: you have no berries

3.name: Toth
3.temperament: practical, wants to lead, proud; cautious
3.wants: to understand how things are made
3.memory: I am very hungry. I will eat a fish to stave off hunger, then help Yas move things from (18,11) and (19,12) to her store at (17,5). I am carrying a heavy load.

beliefs.Keshain: Keshain is my kin and I should reconnect if I find them during my travels.
beliefs.Hothtair: Hothtair is a reliable builder who shares the goal of securing our survival.
beliefs.Yas: A loyal partner in survival who shares my commitment to the group's needs.
beliefs.Yashlo: He is near death and requires urgent food support to survive.
beliefs.Dal: He is struggling but shows resilience; I must continue to provide him with food to aid his recovery.
beliefs.Hikton: Still untrustworthy, but we are currently enduring the winter in the same area.
beliefs.Vuk: He understands the urgency of winter and cares about survival.
beliefs.Thath: He is in a desperate state and needs my help.

4.name: Yashlo
4.temperament: proud, honest to a fault, values safety above all; cautious
4.memory: Day 31 of winter. I am near death and starving. I gathered 1 berry and must eat it to survive. I will attempt to get some wood and rest in my shelter soon.

beliefs.Hikton: A gatherer nearby, must be careful to keep my distance.
beliefs.Dal: Kind, but creates an unwanted obligation.
beliefs.Toth: A passerby that I must avoid to stay alone.
beliefs.Bekyo: A stranger who came into view near me.
beliefs.Vuk: Friendly, offered me food and tried to help, but I prefer to be left alone.

events: You could not eat berries: you have none, or it is not food.

5.name: Turyol
5.temperament: sly, protective of the weak, hot-tempered; steady
5.wants: to be free of anyone's rule
5.memory: Spring is continuing. I am gathering berries to build up my supplies. Yas and Toth are nearby. Hikton has appeared. I'll gather more berries and then store them. I must keep my food in my store at (21,19) to stay independent.

beliefs.Dal: Reliable kin and hunting partner, but I must remain independent.
beliefs.Thath: A gatherer who prefers community; best to keep a distance to preserve my autonomy.
beliefs.Sirfai: A capable gatherer, but I maintain my independence from their communal ways.
beliefs.Deas: A new person in the area; monitor from a distance and avoid interaction.
beliefs.Vuk: A hunter I do not know; keep a distance to preserve my autonomy.

6.name: Dal
6.temperament: vengeful, welcoming to strangers, forgiving; bold
6.wants: to know every corner of the land
6.memory: I am starving (0/20) and badly hurt (2/10) in winter. I am resting in my shelter at (18,2) to survive and heal. Yas is a kind friend who promised food.

beliefs.Turyol: A reliable hunting partner and kin.
beliefs.Thath: Trying out crafting new materials at night.
beliefs.Sirfai: Building shelters near the deer herd.
beliefs.Deas: A fellow traveler spotted near the eastern edge.
beliefs.Yas: Extremely kind, generous, and a literal lifesaver.
beliefs.Hikton: Kind and generous; shared berries when I was starving.
beliefs.Yashlo: Died of starvation; a reminder of the winter's harshness.
beliefs.Keshain: A heavily laden traveler looking gaunt near the northern edge.
beliefs.Bekyo: A traveler seen gathering berries near the northern edge.
beliefs.Toth: A loyal and generous friend who helps me.

7.name: Bin
7.memory: I am starving and near death. I must survive. I am going to Saspi's store at (4,22) to take food and save my life.

beliefs.Bekyo: Too social; she is my sibling but her presence compromises my need for solitude.
beliefs.Hothtair: A restless stranger who is too social for my liking; best avoided.
beliefs.Deas: A new person in the area. Best to keep my distance.
beliefs.Keshain: A stranger who is too close; must be avoided to ensure my privacy.
beliefs.Mosmu: Too close for comfort; a threat to my solitude.
beliefs.Measmor: A desperate soul, but I have no food to share.
beliefs.Saspi: Dying and has a store with potential food.
beliefs.Tokvi: Too close; best to warn him away from my shelter.

8.name: Bekyo
8.temperament: protective of the weak, restless, loyal to friends; very cautious
8.memory: I am Bekyo. Winter is 4 days away. I am near death (health 1) and very hungry (fullness 2). I must prioritize eating and resting to recover health. Survival is essential for my goal of peace.

beliefs.Bin: My sibling; still values privacy, which I respect.
beliefs.Hothtair: Looks gaunt and in need of food.
beliefs.Thath: They have appeared in the darkness; I hope to keep our meeting peaceful.
beliefs.Keshain: Deceased. I buried their remains with honor.
beliefs.Yashlo: A fellow gatherer; recently seen nearby.

9.name: Yas
9.temperament: wants to lead, generous, curious; bold
9.memory: I am Yas. Goal: start a family. Toth is my partner. Thath and others have passed. I carry fibre 11, fish 2, stone 3, wood 3. I need to secure Thath's items at (19,12) and move them to my store at (17,5). I value Toth's loyalty and Hikton's reliability. It's spring, summer is approaching.

beliefs.Hikton: Reliable kin and essential for survival.
beliefs.Toth: A deeply loyal and essential partner who consistently shares fish and supports our survival.
beliefs.Keshain: A newcomer who has just arrived in our area.
beliefs.Thath: A generous individual who has now passed away.
beliefs.Sirfai: A new face, seemingly capable at gathering.

Toth whispered to you: "I'll eat this fish first."

10.name: Hikton
10.memory: I am at (19,12). I carry meat 6, wood 4, fibre 9, hide 1, bone 1. Load 18.0. I'll pick up items from the ground at (19,12). I'll offload to Yas's store (17,5). I've lost Vuk and Thath. Toth is angry with me. Yas is my kin. I'll offload meat 6, wood 4, fibre 9, hide 1, bone 1, stone 2, and fibre 24.

beliefs.Yas: Focusing on gathering berries for the coming winter.
beliefs.Toth: Aware of my theft attempt and unwilling to trade with me.
beliefs.Sirfai: A new person in the area; I should watch what they carry.
beliefs.Vuk: A loyal hunting partner who is currently extremely weak and dependent on my support.
beliefs.Thath: He is starving but useful as a gatherer.
beliefs.Deas: A capable hunting partner who has survived the winter.
beliefs.Tolgair: Resting near Vuk's grave in the morning.

11.wants: to understand how things are made
11.memory: Day 42 night. I'm starving and near death. Toth promised to help me. I owe Hikton for his kindness. I need food immediately. I'll pick up the stone and wood from the ground. I intend to gather berries and stone once I'm fed.

beliefs.Dal: He is near death and needs urgent food to survive.
beliefs.Turyol: Prefers to keep his resources to himself, as his store is closed.
beliefs.Hikton: Generous and practical; saved me from starving.

beliefs.Vuk: A polite newcomer, potentially an ally.

12.name: Sirfai
12.temperament: proud, fond of stories, wants to lead; cautious
12.memory: Thath is dead, but they were my kin. I must stay safe and gather food. I will gather berries and store them for later. Mosmu is dead; I will collect resources from their store at (9,17) and (8,17) when I have space. I must stay cautious of wolves in the forest and Turyol.

beliefs.Turyol: Turyol is back in view nearby. Keep distance and stay cautious.
beliefs.Deas: A masterly gatherer seen active nearby.
beliefs.Dal: Suffering from injuries, struggling to maintain strength.
beliefs.Toth: A skilled fisher who recently returned to the area.
beliefs.Yas: A stranger who has appeared nearby gathering berries.
beliefs.Vuk: Vuk has passed away, leaving behind supplies at (19,12).
beliefs.Saspi: A traveler carrying heavy stone and looking gaunt nearby.
beliefs.Mosmu: Passed away due to wolf attack.

13.name: Hothtair
13.temperament: dislikes being told what to do, values safety above all, gentle; reckless
13.wants: to be remembered after you are gone
13.memory: I am Hothtair. I was at the brink of death but Keshain saved me with food. My goal is to recover my health by resting and to survive. I owe Keshain everything; they are my only true ally. I must find a way to leave a lasting legacy before my time ends.

beliefs.Keshain: My savior and most trusted ally; they are the reason I am still alive.
beliefs.Bin: Bin is leaving the area due to crowding.

14.name: Mosmu
14.temperament: gentle, welcoming to strangers, ambitious; steady
14.memory: I am Mosmu. I must survive the starvation and the wolves. My primary goal is to reach my shelter at (8,17), lock it, and then venture out only when necessary to gather food. I am currently near death and must avoid Measmor and others to preserve my solitude. I must heal quickly.

beliefs.Bin: Neighborly, but too close for my comfort; I will maintain distance.
beliefs.Thath: A neighbor whose proximity is an intrusion; I must avoid them to remain alone.
beliefs.Sirfai: A neighbor who speaks to me too often; I must remain distant.
beliefs.Measmor: Too persistent in trying to include me in group affairs; I must maintain my distance.
beliefs.Tokvi: A newcomer gathering wood nearby; I will keep to my shelter.
beliefs.Saspi: A newcomer gathering nearby; I will stay away and remain alone.

events: You struck at the wolves (3) and were bitten (1).
Wolves are on you! You lost 2 health.

33.name: Vuk
33.temperament: welcoming to strangers, restless, wants to lead; bold
33.wants: to be looked up to by others
33.memory: I am Vuk. I am nearly dead from starvation but I have found meat. My priority is to eat, heal, and continue hunting with Hikton. I aim to be a leader who provides for the group and is respected by others.

beliefs.Yas: A gatherer I should keep an eye on.
beliefs.Deas: A strong partner in the hunt who helped secure food.
beliefs.Toth: A loyal and hardworking ally who understands the necessity of preparation.
beliefs.Yashlo: He is badly hurt and needs rest to recover before winter.
beliefs.Hikton: A loyal companion who stands with me in the cold to keep us alive.
beliefs.Thath: A newcomer who spoke peacefully to me on a winter night.
beliefs.Sirfai: A new arrival, likely a useful gatherer for our community.
beliefs.Turyol: A capable gatherer who has joined our group.

34.name: Measmor
34.memory: I am Measmor, leader of Winter Survivors. I am near death and starving (0 fullness). Tokvi is dead. Winter is ending in 2 days. I need food immediately. I'll go to (2,23) to see if there's anything else around. I'll collect wood and stone to be prepared. I must find food.

beliefs.Saspi: Saspi is desperate and tried to rob me when starving.
beliefs.Mosmu: Too proud to ask for help, but clearly fading.
beliefs.Tokvi: Tokvi is still enduring the winter by my side.

36.name: Saspi
36.temperament: devout about promises, generous, fond of solitude; cautious
36.wants: to be remembered after you are gone
36.memory: I am Saspi. I am starving and badly hurt in winter. I must rest in my shelter to heal. I have 4 stone for my monument. Measmor cannot be trusted.

beliefs.Bin: Bin prefers solitude and asked others to leave, which I respect as it aligns with my own needs.
beliefs.Measmor: He tried to steal from me, so I cannot trust him.
beliefs.Mosmu: A good gatherer with a home to the northeast.
beliefs.Sirfai: A stranger who has appeared near my territory; I will keep my distance.
beliefs.Tokvi: A newcomer who has encroached upon my territory; I must remain cautious and keep to myself.

42.name: Tokvi
42.temperament: hungry for respect, values fairness above all, curious; very cautious
42.wants: to be looked up to by others
42.memory: I am at (6,22) with Measmor. I am starving (0/20 fullness) and near death (1/10 health). Winter ends in 2 days. I must find food or rest to survive.

beliefs.Bin: Bin has passed away from starvation.
beliefs.Measmor: Leader of Winter Survivors, also suffering in the winter cold.
beliefs.Mosmu: A newcomer; should be welcomed but watched cautiously.

events: Measmor whispered to you: "Tokvi, there is no food in our store. I am going to search the nearby abandoned stores and try to find anything we can eat. Stay here and rest to conserve your strength."
Measmor whispered to you: "Tokvi... we must hold on. Spring is almost here."
Tokvi of Winter Survivors is dead.

52.name: Tolgair
52.temperament: likes to bargain, forgiving, hot-tempered; reckless
52.memory: I am Tolgair. I aim to lead. I have meat and I want to stock up on it. I intend to visit Yas's store at (17,5) to store some of my meat so it doesn't spoil. I will gather berries to help the group. I'm joining Deas to hunt the deer herd.

53.name: Drean
53.temperament: restless, fond of solitude, gentle; steady
53.memory: I am at (2,11) in the forest. I have 3 berries. I am full and healthy. I will seek food to prepare for summer. I will gather berries and wood.

38.name: Winter Survivors
38.rules: We gather and store food together to survive the winter cold.
